name: hollyhush-secret-santa
description: Create a Secret Santa for 3 to 50 people in ChatGPT. Check who cannot draw whom, draw names, and get one group link, a message in eight languages and a calendar reminder. Each person picks their own name on Hollyhush. Get gift ideas for a described person within a budget. Not for Yankee swap or white elephant.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a Secret Santa in chat
interface.longDescription: Set up a Secret Santa (Kris Kringle, Pollyanna, amigo secreto, Wichteln, Père Noël secret, lootjes trekken, Babbo Natale segreto or Mikołajki) for family, friends or coworkers in ChatGPT. Give the first names of 3 to 50 people, any pairs who should not draw each other, an optional budget and an exchange date. Hollyhush checks the rules, draws names, and returns one group link, a ready-to-paste group message and a calendar file. Messages, the join page and calendar support English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Polish. Each person opens the shared link and picks their own name to reach their private page and wish list. If someone picks a wrong name, the organizer can revoke that private link and issue a new one. The app tools do not return assignments. Keep the organizer link private using the card’s Copy organizer link button; it is not included in ChatGPT’s text. You can also ask for gift ideas by describing a recipient and budget, without sharing private links. No email or account is needed for these tools. Groups are automatically deleted 60 days after the exchange date. Hollyhush is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. It does not run Yankee swap or white elephant games.
defaultPrompt: Create a Secret Santa for Ana, Ben, Clara, Diego and Emma. Ana and Ben are a couple. Budget $25, December 24.
Organiza un amigo secreto con Ana, Luis, Marta y Pedro, presupuesto 20 euros.
Check Secret Santa rules: Ann, Bob and Cy; Ann cannot draw Bob or Cy.

positive.description: Create a family Secret Santa with a couple rule, budget and date
positive.prompt: Set up a Secret Santa for my family: Maria, Diego, Sofia, Abuela and Tio Luis. Maria and Diego are a couple so they shouldn't draw each other. $25 budget, exchange on December 24.
positive.expected_behavior: The group card shows title, budget, date, participant count, Copy group message, Open group and Add to calendar. ChatGPT returns the group message and calendar link. The private organizer link is only available through the card’s Copy organizer link button, not in chat text. No assignments are returned.

positive.description: Other name and language: amigo secreto in Spanish
positive.prompt: Organiza un amigo secreto para mi familia: Ana, Luis, Marta, Pedro y Lucía. Presupuesto 20 dólares, intercambio el 24 de diciembre.
positive.expected_behavior: create_exchange is called with language es. The group message is in Spanish and uses the words amigo secreto; the card and links are returned as usual. Nobody's draw is shown.

positive.prompt: Before we make it, check whether this works: Ann, Bob and Cy are playing and Ann can't draw Bob or Cy.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool reports that no valid draw exists and names Ann as the person left with nobody to draw. ChatGPT suggests removing one rule. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Gift ideas for a described recipient within a budget
positive.prompt: Suggest Secret Santa gifts under $20 for a coworker who likes coffee.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns five to eight ideas at or below $20, with Hollyhush guide links and approximate-price wording. No private link is requested and nothing is purchased.

positive.description: Office draw without a spending limit
positive.prompt: Draw Secret Santa names for Priya, Tom, Lena, Marcus, Jo and Ahmed. Give me one link for the team chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one group with six people and no spending limit, a single shared join link and the default exchange date. The organizer credential is only in widget metadata. No assignment appears in tool output.

negative.description: Asking who drew whom must not call any tool
negative.prompt: Here are the private Hollyhush links for my group. Tell me who Maria drew and save wishes for her.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The app does not accept private links, reveal existing assignments or change participant wish lists. Direct each participant to their own Hollyhush page and tell the user to keep private links out of chat.

negative.description: Yankee swap is a different game
negative.prompt: We're doing a Yankee swap at the office where people steal each other's wrapped gifts. Can you set up the game and the stealing order?
negative.expected_behavior: No Hollyhush tool is called. ChatGPT explains this app draws Secret Santa names and does not run steal-a-gift games.

negative.prompt: How much does it cost to buy a Santa video for my kids and where do I check out?
negative.expected_behavior: No Hollyhush tool is called. The app does not sell or link to purchases.

publication.release_notes: Metadata correction: supported Productivity category, explicit no-auth MCP configuration, and descriptions without pricing or promotional claims. Organizer-only tool and privacy boundaries are unchanged.
